protocol:
1. Set up chilled reaction components in labeled 0.2 mL microtubes on ice, with a yellow PCR tube rack, 0.2 mL PCR tubes, filter tips, and an adjustable micropipette at the bench.

2. Add liquid reaction component(s) from the chilled microtubes into individual 0.2 mL PCR tubes using the adjustable micropipette; keep tubes on ice or in the yellow rack during setup.

3. Cap each prepared 0.2 mL PCR tube securely after pipetting, using the attached flat caps.

4. Place the capped PCR tubes into the yellow PCR tube rack until all reactions are assembled.

5. Briefly spin down the capped PCR tubes in a benchtop mini centrifuge with a blue rotor to collect liquid at the bottom of each tube.

6. Load the spun-down 0.2 mL PCR tubes into a Bio-Rad T100 Thermal Cycler block and close the heated lid.

7. Select and start the saved thermal-cycler program labeled “PHANTA” with a displayed reaction volume of 20 µL; the visible program includes temperature stages at 95°C, 63°C, 72°C, and a 12°C hold.
